This position requires a seasoned professional who can manage complex executive schedules, coordinate sensitive business matters, and maintain effective communication across multiple departments and external business relationships. The Senior Executive Assistant will work closely with executive leadership, Finance, and Operations to coordinate business activities, prepare management materials, and support financial administration. We are looking for a dependable professional with excellent organizational judgment, extensive executive support experience, and the ability to operate independently in a demanding business environment. Key Responsibilities Provide high-level administrative support to senior executives, including calendar management, travel coordination, and meeting scheduling. Manage executive correspondence, confidential communications, and relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Prepare executive presentations, business reports, meeting agendas, and confidential corporate documents. Assist with expense reporting, administrative budget tracking, invoice documentation, and financial record coordination. Work with Finance and Operations to organize management reports, financial summaries, and business planning materials. Coordinate executive meetings, record important decisions, and monitor follow-up actions and deadlines. Maintain accurate records of corporate contracts, financial information, vendor agreements, and executive correspondence. Support special projects involving executive administration, business operations, and commercial coordination. Communicate professionally with senior managers, financial advisers, clients, and external business partners. Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes, executive workflows, and organizational efficiency. Qualifications Minimum 15 years of professional experience in executive assistance, senior administration, or corporate office management. Extensive experience directly supporting CEOs, Senior Vice Presidents, Managing Directors, or other senior executives. Strong understanding of executive office operations, confidential business communications, and corporate administrative procedures. Experience assisting with financial documentation, expense management, budget tracking, and executive financial reporting. Demonstrated ability to manage complex schedules, coordinate strategic meetings, and support cross-functional business activities. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, spreadsheets, presentation software, and remote collaboration tools. Excellent organizational judgment, professional communication, attention to detail, and discretion. Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and maintain confidentiality in sensitive business matters. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Management, or a related field is preferred. Ideal Candidate You are an accomplished executive support professional with at least 15 years of experience working closely with senior corporate leadership. You understand how to anticipate executive needs, manage demanding schedules, and coordinate important business activities with professionalism and discretion. You are comfortable handling financial documentation, expense reports, budget information, and confidential corporate records. You bring strong business judgment, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with executive teams and external business partners. Most importantly, you are dependable, proactive, and capable of providing the trusted administrative support needed to help Fairmate Libya's senior leadership operate efficiently and remain focused on business priorities.
